summary.text: Foung Hawj is a Democratic state senator who represents District 67 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Toby Hesselgrave.
He has served in the Senate since January 2013 and works as a multimedia producer.

paragraphs.text: Hawj has a bachelor's degree from the University of Kansas and a graduate degree from the Rochester Institute of Technology, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as multimedia producer.
Hawj assumed office in the Minnesota State Senate on January 8, 2013, and was re-elected as an incumbent in 2020 and 2022.

His 2025-2026 committee assignments are Jobs and Economic Growth Finance and Policy, Transportation Finance and Policy, and Environment and Natural Resources Policy and Legacy Finance, which he chairs.
